defect: _gold_rank now counts a hit whenever unit_path merely starts with the gold article string (h['unit_path'].startswith(art)), where it previously required the article itself or a частина under it (h['unit_path'] == art or h['unit_path'].startswith(art + '/')), so ст.8 matches ст.80 and ст.21 matches ст.210 — a different article scores as the gold one.
consequence: The retrieval measurement silently over-counts: recall@k, p@1 and MRR@k (the numbers published in docs/RESULTS.md) can be earned by an article the gold never named, and the miss it hides is the corpus-growth regression the baseline exists to catch. The committed test that pins this exact rule now fails, so the project's definition-of-done gate is RED.
proof: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_gold_rank.py -v → FAIL test_a_longer_number_is_a_different_article: 'AssertionError: 1 is not None' for _gold_rank([{A,ст.210},{A,ст.21-1}], [(A,ст.21)]) — a longer number is now rank 1. python -m verification.gates → 'RED: 4/5 gate(s) passed; failed: unit-tests' (336 tests, 1 failure). Mechanism on a real gold shape — gold row id 13 is '4695-20 ст.8': top=[{4695-20,ст.80},{4695-20,ст.8}] gives BEFORE rank 2, AFTER rank 1. Honest scope: replaying both versions over the committed frozen baseline eval/baselines/retrieval_2026-07-19_14acts.jsonl (29 questions x top-10) changes no rank today (recall 29/29 and p@1 27/27 both before and after) — that 11-act corpus happens to contain no colliding article in any top-10 — so the defect is latent and fires as the corpus grows, not a change in the currently published table. Nineteen of the 29 gold rows carry a one- or two-digit article (ст.5, ст.7, ст.8, ст.9, ст.12, ст.15, ст.20, ст.22, ст.23...), each of which now prefix-matches a decade of other articles of the same act. Note also that eval/retrieval_baseline.py (lines 71 and 112) still matches exactly, (h['act'], h['stem']) in want, so the two retrieval instruments now disagree about what a hit is. Contract broken: tests/test_gold_rank.py docstring, 'never a different article that merely shares a prefix (ст.21 is not ст.210)', and eval/README.md line 47, where the article level is the unit of truth and only частини/пункти underneath it match by prefix.
